ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Patterns of Fraud in Fundraising Platforms
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial transactions and fundraising practices of various platforms, including ActBlue, to identify potential patterns of fraud or abuse.
questions: What are the potential risks and vulnerabilities in fundraising platforms?
How can these platforms be held accountable for ensuring the integrity of their financial transactions?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and fundraising practices of these platforms, we may be able to identify potential patterns of fraud or abuse, and shed light on the need for increased scrutiny and accountability in this area.
